title: Guillaume Gellusseau to lead brand strategy for Kilian Paris and Frédéric Malle
summary: The Estée Lauder Companies has appointed Guillaume Gellusseau as Senior Vice President, Global Brand, for Kilian Paris and Éditions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, effective August 2026. Based in Paris, he reports to Jo Dancey, Global President, Lifestyle Fragrance Brands. In his new role, Gellusseau will oversee the long-term strategy and continued development of both fragrance brands.
